extracted.name: Caesar Wrap
extracted.description: This Caesar wrap is a healthy, make-ahead lunch or easy dinner! Filled with the best parts of a Caesar salad, it's fresh and flavorful. Skip the cheese and use my vegan Caesar dressing to make it vegan.
ingredient_lines: ⅓ cup cooked chickpeas (drained and rinsed)
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
Homemade Caesar Dressing or Vegan Caesar Dressing
instruction_lines: Place the romaine, kale, radicchio, chickpeas, avocado, and red onion on a cutting board. Top with shaved Parmesan, if using, and squeeze with lemon juice. Season with sprinkles of salt and pepper.
Drizzle generously with the dressing and roughly chop everything on the cutting board, mixing it together as you chop.
Load the salad mixture into the tortilla and fold to close. Serve with more dressing on the side.
